summary: Iteration 3 (v4) full backend + frontend regression for MemoryTransfer. All 45 backend pytest tests pass (12 core + 22 v3 + 11 new v4/streak). New Streak Lab endpoints (/api/challenges/active, /api/streak/me, /api/streak/leaderboard, POST /api/streak/vote) verified end-to-end with correct increment/reset behaviour. Fonte Zero external_link_url present on every seeded alert; profiles=21 across Serie A/B/C/Premier League with verified_status set for 9 star profiles; recent rumors now enriched with contract_expiry & verified_status and sorted by logged_at desc. Frontend: Streak Lab gateway → Google-mock spinner → arena flow works, correct SI vote extends streak w/ green toast, wrong NO resets to 0 w/ toast; 5-row leaderboard sorted by highest_streak desc. Radar has 7 verify-source links with target=_blank and http hrefs; Sources page shows blue verified check for 4 sources with score>85 (Romano 96, Di Marzio 92, Sky 90, Schira 87); Apply for Verification modal opens, submits and closes with success toast. Contract Mismatch badge appears on Lookman card (dashboard) and Lookman profile Timeline tab for the free-transfer Anonymous ITK rumor. Language toggle switches IT↔EN across views. Sidebar unchanged with new nav-streak flame item.

issues: Cosmetic/design consideration: coach rumors seeded with deal_formula='Free Transfer' (e.g. Cesc Fàbregas, Grosso, Dionisi, Gilardino) trigger the CONTRACT MISMATCH badge for coaches whose contract runs beyond 2026 (Fabregas 2028). Algorithmically correct given lib/consistency.js threshold (year > currentYear + 'free transfer' formula), but semantically the term 'Free Transfer' is used loosely for coach moves. Consider either narrowing the mismatch algorithm to role=='Player', or using a different deal_formula label for coach rumors in seed_data.py (e.g. 'Free' or blank). Not a bug — noted for design polish.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: decide whether CONTRACT MISMATCH badge should apply to Coach rumors that use 'Free Transfer' deal_formula (currently triggers for Cesc Fàbregas etc.). Either scope the check to Player role or change coach rumor formulas in seed_data.py.
critical_code_review_comments: StreakLabView: leaderboard is fetched from /api/streak/leaderboard which returns top-5 by highest_streak; 'You' (u-you highest=9) is NOT in the top-5 (all mock users are 11+), so the 'isYou' highlight path is never exercised at seed. Consider showing 'You' separately if not in top-5 for stronger UX, OR ensure u-you seed highest_streak is high enough to appear at least occasionally.
server.py POST /api/streak/vote does an upsert on u-you but never seeds u-you at first vote if streak_users collection is empty — safe because seed_db pre-inserts u-you. Still fine.

lib/consistency.js triggers on 'Free Transfer' formula for anything with contract_expiry year > currentYear. It does NOT scope by profile.role, so coach rumors using 'Free Transfer' formula produce mismatch badges — see design_issues above.

seed_data.py uses fixed external_link_url = google.com/search — acceptable for demo but a real 'Original Source' link would ideally be per-source (Romano X post, Sky article, etc.). Consider a `source_url` field on Rumor for production.
server.py `_extract_json` still uses greedy regex first; try json.loads before regex fallback — same suggestion as iteration_2.
App.js has grown to 235 lines with 12 state hooks + 8 handlers. Approaching complexity threshold; consider extracting a useTransferMemory hook or context per view family.
test_transfer_memory.py & test_v3_features.py had 3 stale assertions from v3 (Napoli, Thiago Motta, 3 Osimhen rumors) — fixed by testing agent to reflect v4 seed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All v4 (iteration_3) features work end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_transfer_memory.py, test_v3_features.py and test_streak_v4.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests -v`. AI Claude is LIVE (radar/scan + article draft + consistency). Streak vote endpoint mutates u-you streak — tests explicitly reset via a wrong vote first, so ordering is idempotent. If seed_version bumps again, re-check the three previously-stale assertions (Osimhen club, coach name, number of Osimhen rumors, and any p-{id} used in POST /rumors test). The CONTRACT MISMATCH badge is intentionally strict: it fires anytime deal_formula=="Free Transfer" AND contract_expiry year > current year (currently 2026) regardless of profile role.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iteration_3. The 3 initial regression failures were stale test assertions from iteration_2 (v3 seed) that had not been updated for the v4 seed (Osimhen moved Napoli→Galatasaray, Thiago Motta removed, rumor counts changed).
